description: This Java source file defines the HumanResEvents class, which contains static methods for retrieving and constructing hierarchical data related to human resources, such as employee details, organizational units, and relationships, formatted for use with a jsTree component.

classes.name: HumanResEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate hierarchical HR data for UI components like jsTree, including employee details, organizational units, and relationships.

methods.name: getChildHRCategoryTree
methods.description: Main method to retrieve hierarchical HR data based on request parameters, populating the request attribute 'hrTree' with the data.

methods.name: getCurrentEmployeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of current employee positions and their fulfillments, formatted for UI display.

methods.name: getChildComps
methods.description: Fetches child organizational units or groups related to a given party group, formatted for UI display.

methods.name: getEmployeeInComp
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific party ID, formatted for UI display.
